rows.text: **Tata Motors** (commercial vehicles) -- October sales of 47,652 units, up 27% YoY from 37,530 (domestic CV 39,784 units, +13%; international business up 225% YoY to 7,868 units).
completes the initial settlement of its tender offer for Iveco Group N.V.; WOS TML CV Holdings now holds 89.42% of Iveco, which becomes an indirect subsidiary (deal value not stated in this filing).
subsidiary TML CV Holdings raises its tender offer for Iveco Group to **EUR 14.40 a share (cum dividend) from EUR 14.10**, calling it its best and final offer.
**raises commercial-vehicle prices by up to 1% from 1 October** to offset commodity and input costs.

under an NCLT Mumbai order of 2 September, sends **notices to shareholders and creditors on the composite amalgamation of TMF Holdings and TMF Business Services** into itself; the meetings are dispensed with but representations are invited.

rows.quant: EUR 14.1 per share, cash; Exor tenders ~27.06%
rows.text: launches its **recommended all-cash voluntary tender offer for all Iveco Group common shares at EUR 14.1 cum dividend**, the acceptance period running 7 September to 26 October
